Title: Azure Data Lake Analytics U-SQL runtime upgrade

Body.Content:
Azure Data Lake Analytics U-SQL runtime is upgrading from .NET Framework v4.5.2 to .NET Framework v4.7.2. This change introduces a small risk of breaking changes if your U-SQL code uses custom assemblies that use .NET libraries.

Learn how to check for backwards-compatibility issues.
